desc: D-pad down in the field opens the Start menu on the Journal (the game's own shortcut, win_main.c) on the headless build: its help is Paper Cut's tag pc_menu_kiroku (src/window/win_root.c's tab row), which only Aurora's journal_hint_aurora.c answered, so headless logged it missing (the full run's Petalburg segment, story 24 in hei_01: here gor_01, where Mario stands at once). Now portHeadlessMsg answers it and the tabs after it (the stick right through Settings, Wardrobe and Online: their help too); the menu closes and Mario walks on
